name: EM FX Carry Across Fed Hiking & Cutting Cycles
description: Analyzes annualized carry (local policy rate minus US Fed Funds rate) for BRL, MXN, and ZAR across Fed hiking and cutting cycles. Carry is computed from FRED central bank rate series: IRSTCB01BRM156N (Brazil), IRSTCI01MXM156N (Mexico interbank rate proxy), IRSTCB01ZAM156N (South Africa), minus FEDFUNDS. Regime detection uses hold_until on Fed Funds rate changes to classify hiking vs cutting periods. Includes a cross-sectional carry time series chart and a summary table of average carry by regime.
source:
# =============================================================================
# EM FX CARRY ACROSS FED HIKING & CUTTING CYCLES
# =============================================================================
# Carry = local policy rate - US Fed Funds rate (all annualized %)
# BRL: IRSTCB01BRM156N (Central Bank Rate)
# MXN: IRSTCI01MXM156N (Interbank Rate, closest proxy to Banxico target)
# ZAR: IRSTCB01ZAM156N (Central Bank Rate)
# Fed: FedFunds via common_economic_indicators
# Regimes: Hiking (rate increase) vs Cutting (rate decrease) via hold_until
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
bar_ts = index()

# =============================================================================
# LOAD POLICY RATES (FRED) & FED FUNDS
# =============================================================================

brl_data = economic_indicators(series_id="IRSTCB01BRM156N")()
mxn_data = economic_indicators(series_id="IRSTCI01MXM156N")()
zar_data = economic_indicators(series_id="IRSTCB01ZAM156N")()
fed_data = common_economic_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.FedFunds)()

# Forward-fill monthly rates to every daily bar
brl_rate = ffill(brl_data.result)
mxn_rate = ffill(mxn_data.result)
zar_rate = ffill(zar_data.result)
fed_rate = ffill(fed_data.result)

# =============================================================================
# CARRY CALCULATION: local rate - Fed Funds
# =============================================================================

brl_carry = brl_rate - fed_rate
mxn_carry = mxn_rate - fed_rate
zar_carry = zar_rate - fed_rate

# =============================================================================
# REGIME DETECTION: Fed hiking vs cutting cycles
# =============================================================================

had_fed = is_valid(fed_data.result)
prior_fed = valuewhen(occurrence=1)(had_fed, fed_data.result)
fed_change = fed_data.result - prior_fed

is_hike_event = had_fed and is_valid(fed_change) and (fed_change > 0)
is_cut_event = had_fed and is_valid(fed_change) and (fed_change < 0)

# Persistent regime: hiking from first hike until first cut, and vice versa
is_hiking = hold_until()(enter=is_hike_event, exit=is_cut_event)
is_cutting = hold_until()(enter=is_cut_event, exit=is_hike_event)

# =============================================================================
# ASSIGN CARRY PER ASSET (for cross-sectional reporters)
# =============================================================================

is_brl = is_asset_ref(ticker="USDBRL")()
is_mxn = is_asset_ref(ticker="USDMXN")()
is_zar = is_asset_ref(ticker="USDZAR")()

carry = conditional_select(is_brl, brl_carry, is_mxn, mxn_carry, is_zar, zar_carry, 0)

# Carry split by regime for summary table
carry_hike = where(is_hiking, carry)
carry_cut = where(is_cutting, carry)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# --- Chart: Carry Time Series for All Three Currencies ---
cs_lines(
    title='EM Carry Over Fed Funds: MXN Led During 2022-23 Hike Cycle',
    category='EM FX Carry',
    y_axis_label='Carry (pp)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    step=StepType.StepRight,
    order=0
)(x_values=bar_ts, y_values=carry)

# --- Table: Average Carry by Regime ---
cs_summary_table(
    title='Average Carry: Hiking vs Cutting Regimes',
    category='EM FX Carry',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    order=1,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title='Average Carry: Hiking vs Cutting Regimes',
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Carry in Hikes (pp)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Carry in Cuts (pp)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(carry_hike, carry_cut)
